about.title: About Montgomery County Public Schools
about.content: Montgomery County Public Schools, also known as MCPS, serves families in Montgomery County, Maryland, in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. The traditional school calendar is used for districtwide planning across elementary, middle, and high school communities.

about.title: How to Use This MCPS Calendar
about.content: Use this page for traditional MCPS calendar planning, including the first day of school, Student Transition Day, early release days, non-instructional days, grading and planning days, systemwide closures, holidays, Spring Break, Winter Break, designated make-up days, and the last day of school. Families should confirm school-specific events, athletics, testing, graduation, and alternate-calendar schools directly with MCPS.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for MCPS Families
content: Student Transition Day is not the regular first day for all students; it applies to transition grades and students new to a school.
MCPS lists multiple early release days, including dates near Thanksgiving and the final day of school.
Some grading and planning or professional development dates are marked as possible make-up instructional days if emergency closures disrupt the school year.
The traditional calendar may not apply to every school program, so families should verify alternate calendars and school-specific events with MCPS.

customSections.label: About MCPS Calendar Structure
customSections.content: The MCPS traditional calendar separates student attendance days from teacher preservice days, grading and planning days, non-instructional days, systemwide closures, early release dates, and designated make-up days. The calendar also identifies marking period end dates and notes that selected no-school dates may become instructional days if schools close for emergencies.

customSections.label: Montgomery County Public Schools Profile
customSections.content: Montgomery County Public Schools is a large Maryland public school district serving Montgomery County communities in the Washington, D.C. metro area. This page focuses on the traditional district calendar used for most districtwide student attendance planning.

customSections.label: MCPS Traditional Calendar vs School-Specific Calendars
customSections.content: The MCPS traditional school year calendar is the source for districtwide dates such as the first day, last day, holidays, early releases, non-instructional days, and systemwide closures. It does not replace school-specific calendars for campus events, athletics, testing windows, graduations, or alternate calendars such as Arcola Elementary School's Innovative School Year Calendar.

customSections.label: Why Families Compare MCPS With Nearby Districts
customSections.content: Families in the Washington, D.C. region often compare MCPS with nearby Virginia and Maryland-area districts when planning moves, childcare, commuter schedules, shared custody calendars, and family travel. Start dates, spring break timing, professional days, and early release patterns can vary significantly even among nearby school systems.

customSections.label: How We Collect MCPS Calendar Data
customSections.content: MySchoolDates reviews the official Montgomery County Public Schools calendar PDFs and extracts student dates, holidays, early release dates, non-instructional days, systemwide closures, grading and planning dates, designated make-up days, marking period dates, and last-day details. The page links back to MCPS so families can verify updates before making final childcare, travel, transportation, or work plans.

customSections.label: MCPS Calendar Review Process
customSections.content: Each MCPS calendar page is checked against the official district calendar source before publication and when MCPS posts revised calendar information.

districtFaqs.q: Which Montgomery County Public Schools calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official MCPS traditional school year calendar for the listed school years.

districtFaqs.q: Does the MCPS traditional calendar apply to every school?
districtFaqs.a: Not always. The official 2025-2026 traditional calendar notes that it does not apply to Arcola Elementary School, which follows the Innovative School Year Calendar. Families should verify alternate-calendar schools directly with MCPS.

districtFaqs.q: Does MCPS have early dismissal days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. MCPS lists multiple early release days during the 2026-2027 traditional school year, including dates before Thanksgiving, before Winter Break, in February, and on the final student day. Families should confirm school-specific dismissal times with MCPS or their assigned school.

districtFaqs.q: How do I add MCPS dates to Google Calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Download the MCPS .ics calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, go to Settings, choose Import & Export, and upload the file. The import is a one-time copy, so families should recheck the official MCPS calendar if the district revises dates.

districtFaqs.q: What are MCPS designated make-up days?
districtFaqs.a: Designated make-up days are dates MCPS may use as instructional days if emergencies or closures disrupt the school year. Families should avoid treating those dates as guaranteed days off until MCPS confirms the final schedule.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Montgomery County Public Schools calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official MCPS calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Montgomery County Public Schools.
